title: lint GATE 6 scans only Odin string literals — the banner's catalog-JSON display strings (the original mojibake source) are unprotected
evidence: tools/lint.sh:54: 'for _f in app/render/*.odin app/main.odin; do'  app/render/crisis.odin:45: 'arch = cat.crises[ac.archetype].display_name'  app/render/crisis.odin:51: 'sp_name = de.set_pieces[ac.set_piece].id'  app/render/crisis.odin:71: 'redesign = cat.crises[ac.archetype].preventive_redesign'  app/render/crisis.odin:67: 'draw_text_c(v, title, x, ty, 15, p.state_critical)'  app/render/crisis.odin:73: 'draw_text_c(v, redesign, x, ty, 12, p.ink)'
detail: The gate added for N-12 scans only Odin string literals. The banner title/redesign strings are built from catalog JSON fields fed to the same byte-truncating draw_text_c; a non-ASCII catalog string ships mojibake into blessed T2s uncaught.
recommended_fix: Extend GATE 6 to scan data/*.json display fields (display_name, preventive_redesign, set-piece id), or assert ASCII on them at catalog load.
